newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds follow international markets up.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds follow international markets up.

text.p: 1630 GMT - The Austrian bond market closed firmer on strong international leads on Monday and traders predicted further upside in the short term.
"The market was very friendly today and continues to look bullish," said one dealer.
Traders said all eyes would be watching to see whether the German Bund future held above 102.20 points.
"There was clear resistance there," said one trader, who expected further upside potential in the region of 102.43/50.
* 10 year benchmark 5.75 pct bond maturing July 2006 down five bps at 100.20 to yield 5.72 (5.71) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 100.34/42 to yield 5.70/69.
* Latest five-year 4.375 bond maturing February 2002 closed down 10 bps at 98.85 in bourse trade to yield 4.64 (4.58) pct, quoted post-market at 99.0/10 to yield 4.61/58 percent.
* Austrian bond future up 20 bps at 109.28 on turnover of 180 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany up one at zero, five-year spread up four bps at 12.
* Money market rates steady with three-month VIBOR at 3.438 and overnight money at 3.13/3.38. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
